summaries.text: This bill makes technical amendments to the U.S. Code to revise references to statutory provisions reclassified to Title 34 (Crime Control and Law Enforcement).

title: To make technical amendments to update statutory references to provisions reclassified to title 34, United States Code, and to correct related technical errors.
